description.advisor-unavailable: The graph service is not answering right now. The deck itself is unaffected.
description.balance: What the deck produces, against what it wants to consume. What the commander supplies counts for more — you have it every game.
description.combos-one-short: The missing piece is one click away from the deck.
description.commander-inferred: No commander set — the analysis assumes {{name}}.
description.commander-only: The advisor reads Commander decks. Other formats will follow.
description.curve-legend: Bars: cards in the deck · line: target curve
description.empty-deck: Put cards into the deck and the advisor will read it.
description.fill: The solver proposes {{amount}} cards — quotas, curve and themes decide. Turning individual cards down re-runs the solve.
description.fill-complete: The deck is already full — nothing to fill.
description.ignored: The advisor never suggests these cards for this deck.
description.no-combos: No known combos in the deck — Commander Spellbook knows nothing here.
description.no-commander: No commander in the deck — without one the advisor cannot scope anything. Put one in the command zone.
description.no-cuts: No cuts proposed — nothing stands out as expendable.
description.no-suggestions: No suggestions — the deck is not obviously missing anything.
description.no-swaps: No exchanges proposed — nothing the deck can spare overlaps with what it is offered.
description.no-theme-signal: Too little theme signal for a profile — the deck has no recognisable direction yet.
description.partial-coverage: {{amount}} cards could not be resolved and are missing from this analysis.
description.quotas: How many cards fill each role, against the target corridor.
description.replace: What does similar work in this slot — replacing swaps the card directly.
description.speed: How fast the analysis reads the deck — defaults to the deck's bracket.
description.swaps: What the freed slot buys. One click takes the left card out and puts the right one in.
description.themes: What the deck is visibly working towards, as shares.
description.themes-cycle: Click to favour → avoid → neutral. Steers the suggestions, not the diagnosis.
description.themes-focus: What the deck is visibly working towards · focus {{focus}}%
description.why-scale: Each axis against the strongest suggestion in this list — the rim means “strongest here”, not “good”.

error.fill-busy: The solver is busy right now — try again in a moment.
error.fill-failed: The fill failed. The deck is unchanged.

toast.card-ignored: {{name}} will not be suggested again — click to undo
